description: This file defines a React component for a multi-tier donation form, including subcomponents for selection tabs and donation form rows, with hooks for state management and external integrations.

classes.name: SelectionTabs
classes.description: Component for selecting donation amount tiers with tabs and confirmation button.

classes.name: DonationFormRow
classes.description: Component for displaying the donation form with editing capabilities.

methods.name: switchTab
methods.description: Handles switching between donation amount tabs.

methods.name: handleAmountConfirmationClick
methods.description: Handles click event for confirming donation amount.

methods.name: selectAmountTabClick
methods.description: Handles selecting a specific donation amount tab.

methods.name: editAmountClick
methods.description: Handles editing the donation amount from the form.
